subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can name six kinds of transport.
I can say: He / She goes to work by …
I can talk about how my family goes to work.

tf.why: Yes! A boat goes on the water.

tf.s: The underground goes under the ground.
tf.why: Right! That is why we call it the underground.

tf.s: We say: He goes to work by a bus.
tf.why: We don't use a after by: He goes to work by bus.

tf.s: We say: She goes to work by train.
tf.why: Great! by + transport, with no a or the.

tf.s: We say: He go to work by car.

tf.why: Yes! A motorbike has two wheels.

tf.s: The secret word in the crossword is boat.
tf.why: Well done! The secret word is boat.
A boat goes on water. A train goes on rails.

tf.s: We use She for a man in the picture.
tf.why: We use He for a man and She for a woman.

boxes.q: Complete: She goes to work ___ train.
Complete: He ___ to work by car.

boxes.why: No a or the after by.

boxes.q: Picture: a woman. Circle He or She.
boxes.why: We use She for a woman.

boxes.q: Which word goes in the crossword with 9 letters?
How many kinds of transport do we learn?
boxes.why: We learn six: bus, boat, underground, train, car, motorbike.

mcq.q: Which transport goes under the ground?
mcq.why: The underground goes under the ground.

mcq.q: Which is a kind of transport?
Which word goes after goes to work?
mcq.why: We say goes to work by …

mcq.q: Correct: He go to work by a bus.
o: He goes to work by bus.
He go to work by bus.
He goes to work by a bus.
He going to work by bus.
mcq.why: We need goes and no a after by.

mcq.q: Picture: a man on a boat. Write the sentence.
o: He goes to work by boat.
She goes to work by boat.
He goes to work by train.
He go to work by boat.
mcq.why: A man, a boat: He goes to work by boat.

mcq.q: Your mum drives to work. What do you say?
o: My mum goes to work by car.
My mum goes to work by boat.
My mum go to work by car.
My mum goes to work by a car.

mcq.q: How do you know to circle He or She?
o: Look at the person in the picture.
Look at the colour of the transport.
mcq.why: A man is He and a woman is She.

o: She goes to work by the train.
She goes to work by train.
He goes to work by car.
He goes to work by motorbike.
mcq.why: We don't use the after by.

mcq.q: A man lives near the sea and works on an island. Which transport is best?
mcq.why: A boat goes across the water.
